title: C# vs Python Translation Table
oneLiner: The same task in both languages, side by side: for reading code in the language you know less, or switching languages before an interview.
keyTakeaway: Most ideas map one to one (List and list, Dictionary and dict, HashSet and set, LINQ and comprehensions, PriorityQueue and heapq). The traps are where they differ: integer division and negative modulo, truthiness, slices versus Substring, dictionary ordering, and Python's mutable default arguments.
explanation:
Each row shows one task written in C# and in Python, using the idiomatic tools of each, not a word-for-word translation. Every snippet runs as shown, with its output in the comments, and the two halves of a row produce the same results unless a comment says otherwise. Search finds a keyword in either language, so typing "heapq" or "PriorityQueue" finds the same row.

Print gives a landscape-friendly two-column copy without the controls. For one language at a time, use the C# Cheat Sheet or the Python Cheat Sheet.
